name: rocket-weapon
brief: Standalone unlit Indian Diwali stick rocket weapon for Siyaraj, based on the supplied product photograph. Horizontal right-facing side view. Red/hot-pink paper cone, short cylindrical red wrapper with marigold-gold bands and a sparse gold motif, long thin supporting stick with red, cream and navy spiral stripes, short gray unlit fuse emerging from the rear of the cylinder. Natural handmade paper-firework silhouette. Deep aubergine outline and two or three hard shade steps. No character or hand. No flame, spark, smoke, glow or lettering; keep the fuse readable for later ignition animation. Fixed proportions and colors across five wrapper variations. Same geometry and identity, wrapper has one bold small marigold-gold star in the red central panel between gold end bands.
